sloka: तम् आत्म पन्चमम् दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः ।वानरैः सह दुर्धर्षः चिन्तयाम् आस बुद्धिमान् ॥६-१७-५॥।।
transliteration: tam ātma pancamam dṛṣṭvā sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ ।vānaraiḥ saha durdharṣaḥ cintayām āsa buddhimān ॥6-17-5॥।।

translations.english: Wise Sugriva the Lord of the Vanara army, a formidable one along with Vanaras, started thinking on seeing Vibheeshana (the fifth one) besides four others.
